adv.dc15yt001.title: Potions recipe book
adv.dc15yt001.description:
To craft the book you must put in the crafting table:
-Three nether wart above
-Three Blaze powder below
-Two water bottles at the sides
-And a book at the center
adv.dc15yt002.title: Renewable Vaults
adv.dc15yt002.description: If you are 2 blocks away from a vault, it will be reseted, as if nobody had opened it
